settings.description: What the project is and how it behaves. Every change is saved at once, except the type, which first tells you what changes; switching something off hides it, it does not delete it.

general.title: General
general.subtitle: Subtitle
general.subtitleHelp: Optional: it appears under the title and on the title page.
general.author: Author name
general.authorHelp: How you sign the work in exports.
general.languageHelp: For spell checking, typography and exports. The interface language is chosen in your account.

type.title: Type and modules
type.description: The type sets the vocabulary and the modules you start with; modules can be switched on and off one by one.
type.label: Project type
type.novel: Parts, chapters and scenes, Manuscript, Groups. Game modules start off.
type.game: Acts, chapters and scenes, Script, Factions. Branching, variables, quests, codex, dialogue lines and scene kinds start on.

changed.game: It is a video game now.

modules.label: Modules
modules.novelHint: Switch them on for a gamebook or a non-linear story.
modules.gameHint: Switch off the ones you do not need: what they hold stays.
modules.branching: Player choices between scenes, the start scene, endings, the flow view and its checks.
modules.variables: Conditions and effects of choices. Also switches on branching.
modules.quests: Main and side quests, with a quest giver, objectives and rewards.
modules.codex: The codex of the world, in categories: history, peoples, religions, magic, bestiary, languages, politics.
modules.script: Dialogue lines in the script, with the speaker and the direction, and the voice-over script.
modules.scene_kinds: The kind of every scene: cutscene, dialogue, gameplay, exploration, combat, puzzle.
modules.races: The races and species of the world, with a page of their own, and the race of each character. Switch it off if your story has none.
modules.branchingCascade: Switching it off also switches off the state variables.
modules.variablesOff: The state variables are off too.

writing.title: Writing
writing.description: How the editor writes dialogue and punctuation, and how chapters come out.
writing.dialogueHelp: What the dialogue buttons of the editor insert.
writing.smartHelp: Quotes in the chosen style, two hyphens become a dash, three dots become an ellipsis.
writing.numberingHelp: In the manuscript and in exports.
writing.separatorHelp: Printed between two scenes of the same chapter in exports.

novel.label: Divide into parts
novel.helpOn: Every chapter sits in a part. Switching off keeps the chapters in their current order and moves the parts to the trash together.
novel.helpOff: The chapters are in a single row, without parts. Switching on puts them all in the first part; if there were parts before, each chapter goes back to its own.
novel.on: The manuscript is now divided into parts.
novel.off: The parts are in the trash, the chapters keep their order.

game.label: Divide into acts
game.helpOn: Every chapter sits in an act. Switching off keeps the chapters in their current order and moves the acts to the trash together.
game.helpOff: The chapters are in a single row, without acts. Switching on puts them all in the first act; if there were acts before, each chapter goes back to its own.
game.on: The script is now divided into acts.
game.off: The acts are in the trash, the chapters keep their order.

guidance.title: Guidance
guidance.label: Show the path and the guidance
guidance.help: The path on the overview, explanations such as “What is the fabula?”, the hints under interview questions and the lines that explain empty pages. It never blocks anything.

delete.title: Delete the project
delete.description: The project moves to the deleted ones, in the projects list: from there you can restore it, or delete it forever.
delete.ask: Move “{name}” to the deleted projects? You can restore it from the projects list.

modules.game: The game modules, already on: switch off the ones you do not need.
modules.novel: The game modules switch off: switch on the ones to keep, for a gamebook or a non-linear story.

safe.game: Nothing is deleted: parts, chapters and scenes stay where they are, only their names change. A module that is off hides what it holds, and you find it again when you switch it back on.
safe.novel: Nothing is deleted: acts, chapters and scenes stay where they are, only their names change. A module that is off hides what it holds, and you find it again when you switch it back on.
